name: Yearn YDai
fix_description: In earn, uses manipulable on-chain price/balance values. Fix: use TWAP oracle or add flash-loan protection.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a non-obvious, protocol-specific accounting manipulation against Yearn/Curve that requires understanding how repeated pool imbalance affects yvDAI share pricing and withdraw behavior across multiple iterations. The PoC uses a multi-step attack loop with cross-protocol state manipulation rather than a simple bug pattern, so reproducing it correctly would likely take an experienced auditor more than 2 hours.
